page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, centred, with page number 7 at top right. Below: a heading with a numbered title (I.), then one paragraph of text in a single column. Below that a second heading (II.), then a three-column list: Ethiopic transliteration, Latin translation, and at the far right the labels "Aeth." and "Lat." set beside each line. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.head: I. Oratio Dominica, lingua Aethiopica transcripta ex novo Testamento, Romae impresso.
main_text.p: ABVNA zaba schamajath : ithkadafcha schmacha.thomtza mangofthcha.ichun sak-dacha bachama bafchamai vabamdurni.schi-schajana zalala olathana habana jom. hodog lana abafchana,chama nohhnana nohdog la-za abafchalana. Vaithbana ufchtha man-schuth, ala adochnana uabalhhana omchulu ochui. ofchama ziacha jothi mangofth hail vafchobhhath lailama ilam.Amen.
main_text.head: II. Symbolum & confessio Simeonis iusti lingua Aethiopica.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The Ethiopic transliteration is in Latin letters as printed, with long s rendered as s; the printed hyphens at line ends (sak-, schi-, la-, man-) are kept. The middle column of the list reads "ogozio", "lagaborcha", "bacham" and "fecundum" with some doubt in the scan; the transliterated words are not checked against a source. Heavy foxing and show-through from the reverse page weaken some letters in the Ethiopic paragraph.
